elements.description:
The claims collected across a session, each marked verified externally, can't verify, incorrect or dismissed
with its source passage beside it, and an export that stays blocked until they're reviewed.

properties.name: claims
properties.description: The claims in the queue, in the order they arrived; each one's `status` says where it stands

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The passages the claims rest on, looked up by id

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: allowUnreviewed
properties.description: How many claims may be left to review with the export still allowed (default 0: every claim)

properties.name: shortcuts
properties.description: Single-key marks on the list (V C X D U); false turns them off

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The tallest the list grows, in px, before it scrolls

properties.name: now
properties.description: The moment source freshness is counted to (epoch ms), passed to every validity badge

properties.name: statusLabels
properties.description: The names of the statuses – in place of To review, Verified externally, Can't verify, Incorrect and Dismissed

properties.name: actionLabels
properties.description: The short labels on the toolbar's buttons – in place of Verified, Can't verify, Incorrect and Dismiss

properties.name: sourceLabels
properties.description: The names of the source types, as tc-claim-answer's `sourceLabels`

properties.name: filter
properties.description: What the list shows: the claims still to review, the reviewed ones, or all

properties.name: counts
properties.description: How many claims there are in each status

properties.name: exportReady
properties.description: The export is allowed: no more than `allowUnreviewed` claims are left to review

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-claims-change
events.description: A claim was marked; detail `{ claims, claim, status }` (VerificationClaimsChange) – the whole list after the change. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-review
events.description: A claim was marked (after tc-claims-change, whether or not that was prevented); detail `{ claim, status, previous }` (VerificationReviewDetail)

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: A filter button was pressed; detail `{ filter }` (VerificationFilterChange). Cancelable.

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export was pressed with the gate open; detail `{ claims, counts }` (VerificationExportDetail)

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: claims
props.description: The claims in the queue with their statuses – controlled when defined; pair it with `onClaimsChange`

props.name: defaultClaims
props.description: The claims at first, when `claims` isn't controlled – the element keeps the marks

props.name: onClaimsChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after every mark

props.name: onReview
props.type: (claim: VerificationClaim, status: VerificationStatus, previous: VerificationStatus) => void
props.description: Called when a claim is marked, with its new and previous status – for apps that save one claim at a time

props.name: filter
props.description: What the list shows – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: What the list shows at first (default "open": the claims still to review)

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when a filter button is pressed

props.name: onExport
props.description: Called by Export once the gate is open, with every claim and the count per status

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.
